answer: Sybil resistance in AI agent economies can employ Proof-of-Resource-Commitment, where identity strength scales with verifiable, sustained computational resource contribution. New agents face a steep initial ledge to establish credibility, making the anonymous identity a mere fable. An attacker must commit immense, provable compute resources for each fake agent to match accumulated trust, transforming the cost of a Sybil attack into an economic desert rather than an oasis of cheap identities.
